newsitem.title: USA: FPC sees Fla. nuke at 100 pct by late Fri.
newsitem.headline: FPC sees Fla. nuke at 100 pct by late Fri.

text.p: Florida Power Corp's (FPC) 825 megawatt (MW) Crystal River nuclear unit 3, which has been operating at reduced power since Monday, is expected to return to full service later today, the company said Friday.

"We're patching holes on a pipe that leads to the circulating water pump. We plan to continue with that until late this afternoon. It should take about four hours to get to full power," said company spokesman Melanie Forbrick.
The Red Level, Fla., unit has been operating at about 84 percent power since early Monday for the planned maintenance, she said.
Florida Power is a subsidiary of Florida Progress Corp.
